items.summary: It was discovered that joblib evaluated the pre_dispatch parameter of the Parallel class as Python code. If an application passed untrusted input to this parameter, an attacker could possibly use this issue to execute arbitrary code.

items.title: USN-9105-1: Apache Jackrabbit vulnerability

items.title: USN-9103-1: HTMLDOC vulnerability
items.summary: It was discovered that HTMLDOC incorrectly handled certain malformed URIs. If a user or automated system were tricked into opening a specially crafted HTML file, an attacker could possibly use this issue to cause HTMLDOC to crash, resulting in a denial of service.

items.title: USN-9101-1: Apache Groovy vulnerabilities
items.summary: It was discovered that Apache Groovy incorrectly handled the deserialization of MethodClosure objects. items.title: USN-9099-1: Eterm vulnerability
items.summary: It was discovered that Eterm incorrectly handled certain escape sequences. An attacker could possibly use this issue to execute arbitrary code if a user displayed specially crafted text in the terminal.

items.title: USN-9098-1: DokuWiki vulnerability
